raw.en:
78. CaCO3(s) → CaO(s) + CO2(g) is what type of reaction?
(A) Decomposition (B) Combination (C) Displacement (D) Double displacement

79. Which of the following equations is balanced?
(A) Mg + O2 → MgO (B) Zn + H2SO4 → ZnSO4 + H2 (C) Fe + Cl2 → FeCl3 (D) H2 + Cl2 → HCl

80. Which of the following causes acid rain in industrial areas?
(A) Chlorofluorocarbon (B) Sulphur dioxide (C) Ozone (D) Carbon dioxide

notes: Pen-mark: Q79 option (C) circled (wrong — Fe+Cl2→FeCl3 is actually unbalanced; correct balanced equation among these is B, Zn+H2SO4→ZnSO4+H2). No marks on Q78, Q80. This is the last page of Section-A — Section-A runs Q1-80 exactly as declared on the cover, confirming full 80/80 objective questions present in this PDF.
